channel.description: A made-up blog for spread-the-word's tests.

item.title: First Light
item.content:encoded:
The garden gets its first light at seven, and the tomatoes lean toward it like they've been waiting all night.

I moved the chair to follow them.

item.title: A list of small things
item.content:encoded:
Things worth keeping track of:

  • Bread rises faster near the window.
  • The neighbour's cat has two names.
  • Most bugs are typos with good PR.

More soon.

item.title: Same day, second post
item.content:encoded: Two posts on one day, to check that ordering by date alone isn't enough.

item.title: Fixing the gate
item.content:encoded: The gate had a loose hinge for a year. It took ten minutes and one screw & a little patience.

item.title: Notes from last autumn
item.content:encoded:
Leaves, "quotes", accents like café and naïve, and a link.

That's all.
